floors_rationale: Conservative round-number lower envelope of initial Parent raw primary performance, not an optimum. Combined 60/65 and documentation 90/90 are minimum engineering utility proposals, not scientific guarantees.
intended_use: Research evidence discovery with source inspection; not autonomous scientific conclusions.
reference_review: Complete technical review is prepared; limited relevance-proxy semantics and the unindexed D-01 diagnostic require explicit Owner review before integration. No automatic ground-truth approval.
regression_rationale: At most one noncritical newly lost question per cutoff and stratum, also against the fixed initial Parent. Gross losses cannot be offset by gains. Small 40/84 denominators favor explicit counts over significance claims.
unknown_rationale: At most one noncritical unknown primary question per stratum; all unknowns count as failure. Critical diagnostic questions are never exempt.
